concepts.label: A · Runic Medallion
concepts.description: Round portrait and a short curved-end HP bar

At1671wide screenshot this entire pair should be under120imagepixels wide. No duplicates. Keep this group separate from the action bar, far enough right not to overlap it or the objective.

DESIGN A: RUNIC MEDALLION. Entirely replace the top-left old status frame. A small round48logicalpx medallion in thin hammered pewter with only four tiny violet rune cuts, nearly black backing and King's expressive complete bust from input2. One very small level12 shield overlaps lower-right of the ROUND frame. Directly beneath the round avatar, centered with it, a compact90logicalpx red HP capsule with slightly curved/stepped ends and a fine silver rim; current/max digits in its center. One tiny dark crescent under the bar visually links the pieces without an enclosing rectangle. No player-name banner, no hanging ornaments. Attractive restrained old-school RPG medallion; health is distinctly below it. The overall shape must be ROUND avatar+short HORIZONTAL health, visibly unlike the original square.

review.scope: Original status/utility concepts over retained screenshot layout; no runtime installation.
limitations: Generated spacing, health fill and text are review approximations, not native measurement evidence.
No actual unlock schedule, new skill glyph assignment, control binding or learned-capacity decision is introduced.
Native contrast at logical960x540, button hit areas, tooltips and varied-biome readability still require implementation review.
